parsed.notes:
The core-skills list is treated as a required tech-stack section; the qualifications section defaults to required except for bullets explicitly marked as a plus.
Seniority treats supporting junior team members as mentoring duty; flagged because support need not necessarily mean mentoring, and the stated 3-to-6-year range also spans levels.
Snowflake security is provisionally mapped to Data Privacy & Security; flagged because the taxonomy entry is broader than the wording.
The at-least-two Cortex alternatives are independently required in the core-skills list except Snowflake CoWork, so no alternative group survives among those entries. Their product-specific skills are unmapped.
The data-engineering/analytics-engineering/data-architecture/AI-ML alternatives and the Streamlit/Native Apps/agent-framework alternatives each have only one mapped member; no mapped alternative group can be formed.
Unmapped entries are required except cost and latency tuning, multi-user concurrency, and Snowflake Native Apps, which occur only in plus-marked qualifications; Snowflake CoWork is a required-section alternative.
SnowPro certification is a credential rather than a taxonomy skill. Industry knowledge, communication, work authorization, and degrees are not skill criteria.
Technologies and practices appearing only in responsibilities, including orchestration, RBAC, masking, and audit trails, are excluded.
